lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated improvements from choose path layout updates, select new flows, and notification additions.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in three winning tests, though specific placements showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Choose path layout updates (choose_path, layout) were helpful in two winning tests, though other variants showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), and home hints (home, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to establish a clear pattern.

candidates.title: Choose Path Stage Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a stage layout featuring an animated mascot and high-visibility choice cards.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 21.5% of users with high mean duration (514s); choose path layout updates previously showed strong conversion gains.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of choose_path screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose path loses 21.5% of users, but full redesigns across steps have consistently underperformed or hurt conversion.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Cloud Sync Notification
candidates.change: Display a cloud sync status badge and explicit hint text on the sign-in screen reassuring users that pet data is saved.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Your pet progress and custom pets automatically sync safely to your cloud account.

guard.reason: Adds helpful sync notification to sign-in screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails regarding data loss; notifications show positive upside in lessons.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Interactive Preview Flow

candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 69.6% with high median (89s) and mean (1017s) setup times.

guard.reason: Adds media preview components to pick_friend step while preserving its function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the biggest drop (30.4%); new flows in adoption show consistent positive lift (+1.1% over 5 tests).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Checklist
candidates.change: Add a real-time progress bar and desktop setup checklist items while custom pet assets finish generating.
candidates.why: Users spend a long time waiting (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 emails reported pets failing to appear on desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of progress checklist to waiting screen during real asset generation.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (2336s) and support emails; home wait_info has a positive track record (+0.9%).

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro overlay within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 28.6% and support emails confirm confusion, but finish redesigns consistently drop conversion.

candidates.title: Story Screen Carousel Layout Refresh

candidates.why: Improving visual pacing on the initial story screen helps drive early funnel engagement before path selection.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen into a carousel while preserving its intro function.

candidates.score_note: Choose path layout updates were highlighted in lessons as winning tests with a positive average (+0.6%).

candidates.title: Sign In Quick Access Badge Flow

candidates.why: Sign-in mean duration is high (567s) and 2 support tickets reported sign-in screen stalling.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Two Column Layout

candidates.score_note: High impact step with clear support email backing; layout changes on adoption are untested but promising.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated gains from adoption new flows, choose path layouts, and home notifications.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in three winning tests, though other placements showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), choose path layouts (choose_path, layout), and home notifications (home, notification) were helpful in multiple winning tests.

Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) hurt performance (causing rollbacks) or showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests of that kind to establish a pattern.
